facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Pengornis has the accession number IVPP V15336.
facts.quote: Its accession number is IVPP V15336.

facts.statement: Pengornis fossils were collected from the Jiufotang Formation at Dapingfang, Chaoyang, Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: It was collected from the Jiufotang Formation, at Dapingfang, Chaoyang, Liaoning China.

facts.statement: A second, juvenile specimen of Pengornis (IVPP V18632) was described by Hu, Zhou, and O'Connor in 2014.
facts.quote: A second, juvenile specimen, IVPP V18632, was described by Hu, Zhou, and O'Connor in 2014.

facts.statement: Pengornis is classified within the family Pengornithidae.
Pengornis lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
